rule_text: R1: assignment per target installation, metadata only. recordings = distinct pool 'measurement' values among the installation's pool windows, sorted ascending as integers; the recording at rank r (0-based) goes to T_adapt if r is even and to T_eval if r is odd. Every window inherits the side of its recording. Recording key = installation + '|' + measurement. A split is FEASIBLE iff every target installation has >= 2 recordings (then each class has >= 1 recording on each side).

warning_thresholds.note: warnings only, not part of the feasibility definition

definitions.target: split 'val' side (5 installations, one per class)

A_column_level.loses: T_adapt and T_eval windows come from adjacent 12-s columns of the same continuous recording (same mounting, same run, same day); only the column boundary separates them

B_time_halves.key: installation|measurement, split by window time order
B_time_halves.loses: both halves come from the same recording; if the boundary is inside one column the last adapt and first eval windows are seconds apart

C_i_eval_only.loses: class absent from T_adapt: the adaptation stage never sees this class in the target domain, so the per-class condition (class on both sides) fails for it; evaluation stays fully recording-independent

C_ii_exclude_from_eval.loses: class has no T_eval data: no metric for this unknown class in that split; T_eval has one class fewer

option_R1_merged.status: OPTION ONLY, NOT ADOPTED. The primary rule is R1 (keys rule_version, splits, per_installation).
option_R1_merged.name: R1-merged
option_R1_merged.rule_text: R1-merged: per installation, connected components of the pool columns, two columns being linked if they share the nominal measurement (column // 5) OR the phase-jump measurement_of_column; recording key = installation + '|m' + component index, components numbered by their smallest column; the same even/odd rank rule as R1 (rank r even -> T_adapt, odd -> T_eval). No window of a nominal or of a phase-jump recording can be on both sides.
